title: Book Serif Index
concept: The Corvina Ledger, the bound session archive of a fictional 1950s Baltimore jazz label: a dark catalog shell with a mono index rail around an aged-paper folio spread (drop caps, marginal notes, a sleeve-and-disc plate, dotted-leader track lists), followed by a catalogue of issues, a personnel register set like a book index, an essay on the masters and a colophon.
notes: Pure CSS paper material (SVG feTurbulence noise, crease and edge gradients) and inline sleeve artwork, so no images are loaded. The rail and the folio arrows (or ←/→ keys) turn between three session spreads; reduced motion removes the line reveals, disc spin and ambient drift.
